hypotheses.R0_candidate_choice_overstates_operation: At least one family that passed the candidate-choice gate fails a full-vocabulary or semantic-output operational gate.
hypotheses.R1_semantic_output_sets_rescue_valid_cla: At least one classification or composition family has semantic top-1 accuracy at least 0.50 despite literal-label top-1 accuracy below 0.10.
hypotheses.R2_exact_retrieval_requires_exact_output: In-context key-value retrieval is operationally competent only if the requested value has median full-vocabulary rank at most two or exact top-1 accuracy at least 0.50.
hypotheses.R3_breadth_survives_output_redteam: At least five families spanning at least four non-identical regimes pass the operational gate.
hypotheses.R4_competent_results_beat_label_permutat: Every operationally competent family has one-sided empirical candidate-choice p at most 0.05 under within-family label permutation.
